news.title: Profit-taking across bitcoin, ether, solana as traders wait on the Iran signing
news.summary: A US-Iran deal pulled oil lower and lifted stocks, but bitcoin's bounce is hesitant. ETF outflows just paused after a record run, and analysts say the market wants the deal signed before pricing it in...
